case.summary: The alert was triggered by a noisy legacy risk score of 0.90 on a $1,000.03 online transaction. However, the second-generation model score is very low at 0.019, which corresponds to a historical fraud rate of just 0.6%. The device used has a generic profile shared by hundreds of cards, providing no strong link to fraud. Furthermore, a prior case on this card was cleared as legitimate, and similar alerts driven by the legacy risk score have consistently been false positives. The evidence strongly points to this being normal activity.
